author: Steve Morris
text: You're Type-2. You took your meds in the morning but didn't eat any breakfast. You had a small lunch, but it wasn't enough. You had simple carbs for a snack... chips, or cookies... your body reacted by creating more insulin... then, since they were simple carbs, you crashed. If it were me, I'd eat a whole-grain and protein meal, maybe add some fruit to lift it a little.
